title: NIST Dictionary of Algorithms and Data Structures: booleanexpr
text:
boolean expression
boolean expression
(definition)
Definition:
An expression consisting solely of boolean variables and values and boolean operations, such as
and
,
or
,
not
,
implies
, etc.
See also
predicate
.
